name: 33529-longctx-16b-1gpu
hardware: 1x NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1), SM90.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, EP off, no decode context parallelism. One in-process vLLM engine, one process, no NCCL.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=1, max_requests=16, warmup the first 25% by completion (12 scored), safety cap 2700 s. streams=1 is the declared operating point, not a search seed.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix_buckets. Prompt exactly 80000 tokens and output exactly 512 (min = max on both), greedy. ignore_eos is forced whenever max_tokens is set, so all 512 tokens are generated; the chat template adds a few tokens, so the engine reports slightly more than 80000.
purpose: A long-document analysis assistant handling 80,000-token prompts one at a time with 512-token replies on a single GPU.
launch:
# The engine's command line. Flat file: every key top-level, every value on ONE line, no inline `#`.
# `trust-remote-code` is required, not decorative: the pinned transformers does not know the
# model_type `deepseek_v2` and AutoConfig cannot load this repo's config without it.
# `attention-backend` is pinned because on SM90 the engine's own MLA priority list would select a
# different backend, and the run would then not be this setup.

model: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V2-Lite-Chat
trust-remote-code: true
attention-backend: TRITON_MLA
tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16
max-model-len: 96000
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
max-num-seqs: 1024
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
